reasons.page:immich: Self-hosted photo server setup needs an address and API key; keep the entire connection form together in Advanced.
reasons.page:albums: This album picker depends on the Advanced Immich connection; classify both steps together.
reasons.page:smb: Network-share setup requires a server, share, path, and optional credentials; keep the complete form in Advanced.
reasons.page:dav: WebDAV photo setup requires a server URL and optional credentials; keep the complete form in Advanced.
reasons.page:web: Displaying an arbitrary web page is a kiosk integration rather than everyday photo selection.
reasons.page:multiroom: Snapcast and Music Assistant connections require server details and credentials; keep the complete connection form in Advanced.
reasons.page:mqtt: Broker publishing, ports, credentials, and TLS are technical automation setup; keep the complete connection form in Advanced.
reasons.page:boot: Automatically launching chosen apps after a restart is device automation.
reasons.page:alpaca: Brokerage API credentials enable a specialist finance integration; ordinary stock watchlists remain basic.
reasons.page:options: Contract type, delta bands, and expiry filters are specialist options-trading settings.
reasons.page:speed: Network throughput testing is a diagnostic tool rather than an everyday preference.
reasons.page:apk: Installing a local APK is technical sideloading; routine app-store browsing is outside this classification.
reasons.page:managed: Automatically managed and legacy fields belong in the Advanced audit; this page remains read-only even with Advanced enabled.
reasons.page:debug: Debug mode and diagnostics are troubleshooting tools.
reasons.control:immortal.hideStatusBar: Overrides system status-bar visibility; the standard appearance needs no platform override.
reasons.control:sources.albumRefresh: Manual album polling cadence is source-maintenance tuning; the photo-source picker remains basic.
reasons.control:screensaver.cacheEnabled: Local caching changes server traffic and device storage use; normal photo playback uses the default policy.
reasons.control:screensaver.batterySaver: Presence-based battery policy is hardware-specific power tuning on a Portal+ mock.
reasons.control:screensaver.presenceMode: Presence-controlled screen power and multi-room playback are automation; scheduled overnight sleep remains basic.
reasons.control:screensaver.idleSleepMin: Adds a separate inactivity screen-off policy; the everyday sleep timer and overnight schedule remain basic.
reasons.control:screensaver.closeAppOnSleep: Closing an app during sleep is process cleanup; sleep timing and audio pause remain basic.
reasons.control:screensaver.ambientDashboard: Adds a specialist ambient dashboard mode beyond everyday photo and clock presentation.
reasons.control:screensaver.gestureWave: Sensor-driven wave-to-wake is a niche hardware interaction override.
reasons.control:dismiss.haPath: Custom Home Assistant dashboard routing is technical; the exit destination and complete Home Assistant setup remain basic.
reasons.control:welcome.durationMs: Millisecond overlay timing is fine tuning; the basic greeting switches remain visible.
reasons.control:welcome.voice: Overrides the system greeting voice with an installed device voice; speaking the default greeting remains basic.
reasons.control:welcome.greetingNight: Overrides the standard nighttime greeting; everyday name personalization remains basic.
reasons.control:welcome.greetingMorning: Overrides the standard morning greeting; everyday name personalization remains basic.
reasons.control:welcome.greetingAfternoon: Overrides the standard afternoon greeting; everyday name personalization remains basic.
reasons.control:welcome.greetingEvening: Overrides the standard evening greeting; everyday name personalization remains basic.
reasons.control:welcome.opacity: Fine tunes the welcome-overlay backdrop; readable text sizing remains basic.
